purpose: Measure how the frozen structural solver and the frozen original-edge enumeration baseline scale with reference-set size N and source budget K on real reference trees; locate the regime where enumeration stops completing while the structural method still finishes. Not a comparison with the published DecoDiPhy software.
selection: All exactly-explainable frozen bank cases binned by reference-set size [(20, 29), (30, 49), (50, 79), (80, 129), (130, 249), (250, 361), (1000, 100000)] and generating K (2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 12); up to 6 per cell, taken at evenly spaced ranks after sorting the cell by (reference_set_size, name). No solver was run before this protocol was written; no outcome-dependent filtering.

tier1.description: Primary paired comparison, both methods, two fresh runs.

tier2.description: Prespecified structural-only frontier probe at a longer wall limit for budgets where tier 1 is expected to censor both methods. Single run; not paired, never substituted into tier-1 statistics.

tier3.description: Prespecified large-N probe on the single 15,941-leaf real case at reduced caps. Answers feasibility within the reduced cap, which is NOT the true minimum of that case.

execution: Jobs run in forked children, at most 20 concurrently, OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL threads pinned to 1. Order is a single seeded shuffle registered here, so repetitions and methods of one case are not systematically co-scheduled. Child CPU time (ru_utime+ru_stime via wait4) is the primary cost measure; process wall time is recorded alongside so co-scheduling inflation can be audited.
analysis: Retain every job including timeouts and errors. Timeouts stay UNKNOWN and are never imputed. Medians and paired ratios use only cases where both methods completed both tier-1 repetitions. Witness verification recomputes the leaf equations on the original tree in exact arithmetic in the parent process.
limitations: Minimum strict source count, not recovery of the generating mixture.
Two repetitions do not justify confidence intervals.
The enumeration baseline is a transparent exact oracle, not DecoDiPhy.
Real exactly-explainable mixtures exist at N=20-361 and at N=15,941 only; the N-fit has no real anchor between 361 and 15,941.
Concurrent execution on a shared machine; CPU time is reported for that reason.
